capabilities.replacement: mcmr graph, diagram, matrix, impact, and simulate
capabilities.reason: Typed graph projections cover structure, reach, boundaries, impact, and proposed change.
The normal check backend is visible without loading or running it.
One streamed kernel pass runs every selected deterministic and contextual rule.
Typed rewrite plans are parsed, applied atomically, and retained only after rule verification.
The live typed catalog exports itself, so generated registry files cannot drift from execution.
Bounded concurrent refresh writes the exact typed fact ordinary offline checks already consume.
Open-ended implementation research belongs to the development agent rather than the analyzer.
Changing judges after a failure obscures provenance and makes repeated checks incomparable.
MCMR separates factual model estimates from policy instead of voting over final judgments.
The engine keeps an explicit typed service boundary without dynamic entry-point discovery.
Providers register by fact family and build only explicitly requested evidence in memory.
MCMR accepts no retained evidence directory or hand-written fact artifact.

capabilities.replacement: kernel facts or stateless provider evidence
capabilities.reason: Evidence provenance remains visible and no hidden pre-check model call manufactures context.
The same CheckReport backs terminal and complete machine-readable output.
Audit runs retain findings while explicitly choosing a zero status.
Checks retain kernel and rule timing while mainboard owns deep CPU and memory profiling.
Typed configuration owns scan, execution, contextual backends, policy, exclusions, and settings.
